edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender of the token transfer.
msg.sender is used to deduct the spender allowance in transferFrom.
lock() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier evaluated against msg.sender.
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender.
setTaxFeePercent is onlyOwner, checked through msg.sender.
setLiquidityFeePercent is onlyOwner, checked through msg.sender.
setMaxTxPercent is onlyOwner, checked through msg.sender.
deliver() uses msg.sender to subtract reflection balance without any access restriction.
excludeFromReward is onlyOwner, checked through msg.sender.
includeInReward is onlyOwner, checked through msg.sender.
lock() computes _lockTime using the miner-influenceable now timestamp.
unlock() compares now > _lockTime, making unlock timing timestamp dependent.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer forwards execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom forwards execution to the internal _transfer routine.
approve writes the spender amount into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify, which triggers external calls to the Uniswap router mid-transfer.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutations to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the per-transaction limit.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth, which makes an untrusted external call.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity, which makes an untrusted external payable call.
swapAndLiquify is wrapped by lockTheSwap, which sets inSwapAndLiquify as a reentrancy guard.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call into the Uniswap router, transferring control to an untrusted contract.
addLiquidity performs an external payable call into the Uniswap router with ETH value.
_tokenTransfer branches eventually call _takeLiquidity to fund liquidity.
_tokenTransfer branches eventually call _reflectFee to distribute reflection fees.
Internal transfer variants call _getValues to compute r and t amounts.
setTaxFeePercent (onlyOwner) mutates _taxFee.
setLiquidityFeePercent (onlyOwner) mutates _liquidityFee.
setMaxTxPercent computes _maxTxAmount = _tTotal.mul(maxTxPercent).div(10**2).
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rTotal without any access control.
deliver adds tAmount to _tFeeTotal, allowing fee-total inflation.
deliver subtracts rAmount from the caller's _rOwned balance.
_takeLiquidity credits the liquidity share to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_getValues derives amounts relative to the total supply accounting.
